# Customjs

CustomJS is a code-first automation platform that enables seamless integration of custom JavaScript logic into various systems and technologies, allowing users to extend applications by writing functions for tasks like sending emails, generating PDFs, or updating CRM data fields.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/customjs/.

## Actions

- **Authenticate CustomJS API Key** (read-only): Authenticate a CustomJS API key.
- **Capture webpage screenshot** (read-only): Capture a screenshot of a webpage.
- **Convert HTML to PDF** (read-only): Convert HTML to a PDF document.
- **Convert HTML to PNG** (read-only): Convert HTML string to PNG image.
- **Merge multiple PDFs into one** (read-only): Merge multiple PDF files into a single PDF.
- **Run Puppeteer Script** (read-only): Run a Puppeteer script and capture a screenshot.
